description: Detect context compaction and transfer long-running Codex work into a fresh verified thread without losing acceptance criteria or evidence.

defaultPrompt: Checkpoint this task and continue it in a fresh verified thread.
Prepare a safe handoff packet for this long-running Codex task.
Check context health and hand off only if a fresh thread is warranted.
interface.longDescription: Detect compaction with a trusted local lifecycle hook, then safely checkpoint and continue long-running Codex work in a fresh verified thread. Preserve language, acceptance criteria, evidence, workspace identity, and open risks. Preflight exact workspace compatibility to prevent approval loops, and verify a titled, pinned destination so handoffs remain discoverable from desktop and mobile.

name: context-handoff
